earnings.title: 301 Water Street SE, Suite 200
highlights: Revenue of $2.2 billion, down 3% on a reported basis and flat organically
Earnings per share of $1.25, up 34%; $1.44 on an adjusted basis, up 5%
The company delivered total revenue of $2.2 billion against a dynamic backdrop.
Third-quarter earnings per share were up 34 percent on a reported basis and 5 percent on an adjusted basis.
Net income attributable to Xylem for the quarter was $291 million, or $1.25 per share.

quotes.text: We’re moving with urgency to shape Xylem around the markets where our capabilities can deliver the greatest customer value and strongest long-term growth.
quotes.by: Matthew Pine, president and CEO of Xylem

outlook: Xylem now forecasts full-year 2026 revenue of approximately $8.95 billion, down 1 percent year over year on a reported basis, versus prior guidance of up 2 percent, and flat on an organic basis, versus prior guidance of up 2 to 3 percent.
Full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin is expected to be approximately 23.2 percent, an increase of 100 basis points versus Xylem’s 2025 adjusted results.
This results in full-year adjusted earnings per share of $5.40 to $5.45, down from the previous guidance range of $5.55 to $5.70.
Full-year free cash flow margin is expected to be approximately 10.2 percent, versus 10.2 to 11.0 percent previously guided.
